title: SAMPLE TENDER DOCUMENT
text:
# SAMPLE TENDER DOCUMENT

Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL)

Tender for Electrical Works – Phase II Extension

nodes.title: 2.1 Bid Submission
nodes.text:
## 2.1 Bid Submission

2.1.1 Mode of Submission

Bids must be submitted electronically through the official procurement portal before the specified deadline.

2.1.2 Required Documents

The following documents must be submitted along with the bid:

- Company registration certificate
- GST registration
- Financial statements for the last three years
- Previous project completion certificates

2.2 Bid Security (Earnest Money Deposit)

2.2.1 EMD Amount

Each bidder shall furnish an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of INR 50,00,000.

2.2.2 Acceptable Forms

The EMD may be submitted in the form of:

- bank guarantee from a scheduled bank
- demand draft payable to BMRCL

2.3 Tender Fees

2.3.1 Fee Amount

A non-refundable tender fee of INR 10,000 must be paid.

2.3.2 Payment Method

Payment shall be made through the online payment gateway provided on the tender portal.

3. Eligibility Criteria

nodes.title: 5.1 Advance Payment
nodes.text:
## 5.1 Advance Payment

An advance payment of 10% of the contract value may be released upon submission of a bank guarantee.

5.2 Interim Payments

5.2.1 Milestone-Based Payments

Payments will be released based on completion of defined project milestones.

5.2.2 Invoice Submission

Contractors must submit invoices along with progress reports and inspection approvals.

5.3 Final Payment

The final payment will be released after successful commissioning and acceptance of all electrical systems.

6. Project Timeline

6.1 Contract Duration

The total duration of the project shall be 18 months from the date of contract award.

6.2 Completion Milestones

6.2.1 Equipment Installation

Installation of electrical equipment must be completed within the first 12 months.

6.2.2 Testing and Commissioning

Testing and commissioning must be completed within the remaining 6 months.

7. Penalties and Liquidated Damages

7.1 Delay Penalty

7.1.1 Delay Rate

A penalty of 0.5% of contract value per week will be imposed for delays beyond the scheduled completion date.

nodes.title: 7.1.2 Maximum Penalty
nodes.text:
### 7.1.2 Maximum Penalty

The maximum penalty shall not exceed 10% of the total contract value.

title: 8. Contact Information
text:
# 8. Contact Information

## 8.1 Tender Issuing Authority

Tender documents are issued by the procurement department of Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited.

## 8.2 Communication

All communication regarding the tender must be addressed to the official BMRCL procurement office in Bengaluru.
